script:
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'
$urls = @('https://dl.google.com/chrome/install/ChromeStandaloneSetupARM64.exe','https://registry.npmjs.org/agent-browser/-/agent-browser-0.41.0.tgz')
foreach ($u in $urls) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $u -Method Head -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 18; @{url=$u;status=[int]$r.StatusCode;bytes=$r.Headers['Content-Length']} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress } catch { @{url=$u;error=$_.Exception.Message} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress } }
